description: Assiettes de servitude A5 liée aux canalisations publiques d'eau et d'assainissement - version numérisée DDT 43 (Direction Départementale des Territoires de la Haute-Loire) - 2017 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. Public utility easements (SUPs) are administrative limitations to the right to property. They are established for the benefit of public persons, concessionaires for public services or public works, private persons engaged in an activity in the general interest. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Easement plates A5 linked to public water and sewerage pipes — digitised version DDT 43 (Departmental Directorate of the" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, DDT 43, HAUTE-LOIRE, open data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
